title: Fix install.sh DOTFILES default leaving broken symlinks
description: install.sh defaults DOTFILES=$HOME/.dotfiles and only bridges the symlink when DOTFILES is overridden. Running ./install.sh from the actual repo location (e.g. ~/Code/Personal/dotfiles) when ~/.dotfiles does not exist creates broken symlinks for every linked file and silently skips brew bundle (since [ -f $DOTFILES/Brewfile ] is false). Fix: default DOTFILES to the directory containing install.sh.
close_reason: Default DOTFILES to script directory; bridge ~/.dotfiles. Re-ran installer: 80 brew deps installed, all symlinks resolve.
